figurative_meaning_en: A mixture of various kinds of items or substances
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই দোকানে পাঁচমিশালী জিনিসপত্র পাওয়া যায়।
জীবনটা একটা পাঁচমিশালি রকমের জটিলতায় ভরা।
example_sentences_in_english: You can find all sorts of miscellaneous items in this shop.
Life is full of a hotchpotch of complexities.
history: Referenced in Rabindranath Tagore's works to describe life's complexities as a mixture.
note: Commonly used in Bengali literature and spoken language to denote diversity or confusion in assortments.
